summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle unrelated to package purpose
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (pinned to v1.3.13), extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-only CommonJS bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, obfuscated with a shuffled numeric/string constant array and a push/shift decoder function. The advertised purpose of the package is a Prismic components library, which has no legitimate reason to fetch a second language runtime at install time or to execute an obfuscated Bun-only payload unrelated to Prismic. Executing the payload via a freshly-fetched alternate runtime evades Node-oriented inspection of what runs during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
